title: Decomposition of continuous Galois sets into embedding sets
statement: Let K be a field [def-pc-field-extension] and Ksep a separable closure. Every continuous discrete action M of Gal(Ksep/K), with its Krull topology, is equivariantly equivalent to a disjoint union of embedding sets of finite separable intermediate fields of Ksep/K.

lean.statement:
theorem galoisSet_embedding_decomposition
    (K Ksep : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ksep] [Algebra K Ksep]
    [IsSepClosure K Ksep] (M : DiscreteContAction (Type u) (Gal(Ksep/K))) :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (E : I → IntermediateField K Ksep),
      (∀ i, FiniteDimensional K (E i)) ∧
      (∀ i, Algebra.IsSeparable K (E i)) ∧
      ∃ e : M.obj.obj.V ≃ (Σ i, E i →ₐ[K] Ksep),
        ∀ (g : Gal(Ksep/K)) (x : M.obj.obj.V),
          e (M.obj.obj.ρ g x) = ⟨(e x).1, g.toAlgHom.comp (e x).2⟩
